svg.title: Tidal Lagoon — A ring of tide-monitoring decks around open lagoon water
svg.desc: An open lagoon sits below a ring of piled boardwalks. Tide stairs reach lower sample pens; a large measuring staff and moored ferry connect the upper loop.
svg.text: A ring of tide-monitoring decks around open lagoon water
An open lagoon sits below a ring of piled boardwalks. Tide stairs reach lower sample pens; a large measuring
staff and moored ferry connect the upper loop.

P1 Tidal Gate Causeway · P2 Coral Market · P3 Divers' Yard · P4 Kelp Apothecary · P5 Tidewharf Landing
